results.remarks:
Tucked behind the gates of Mountain Gate, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath Alta Mira sells the Palm Springs resort lifestyle from the moment you walk in.
The entry hall makes a statement with decorative tile inlays and crown molding that carries throughout the home. From there, the open great room flows past a gas fireplace into a beautifully updated kitchen — but the real showstopper is the pair of French glass door sets framing your private backyard, pool, and unobstructed mountain views.

This kitchen wasn't built for reheating takeout. Slab granite counters, a gas range, stainless appliances, a large pantry, and an oversized island made for gathering — this is where the party ends up every time.

The primary suite is its own private wing, with room for a sitting area or home office, a remodeled walk-in shower, dual vanities, and a walk-in closet that actually fits everything. Bedrooms two and three share a remodeled second bath on the opposite side of the home — perfect for guests, family, or both.

The details that make daily life easier: a dedicated inside laundry room, direct-access two-car garage, and gated RV parking — a rare find on this lot.
Step outside to your own private oasis: an in-ground pool and spa, plus an electric awning for the extra-sunny afternoons when you want a little more shade. It's the backyard that makes people fall for desert living in the first place.

And the community keeps delivering — tennis and basketball courts, a covered BBQ area, a playground, three community pools and spas, and roaming security patrol. All just minutes from Palm Canyon Drive, the Aerial Tramway, and everything downtown Palm Springs has to offer.

Mountain views included. Move-in ready. This is the one.

Situated on a spacious lot on a quiet interior street this home offers a chance to restore, reimagine and create something truly special. Whether looking to create a stylish mid-century retreat, a full-time residence or an investment property the potential is undeniable.  Mature trees both front and back give the home a private secluded feeling.  The back yard offers a modern pool design, Swedish spa (repairs needed) and ample space. results.remarks: Experience luxury desert living at its finest with this fully updated and stylish 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offering a resort-style backyard and beautiful mountain views. Situated on a generous corner lot, this immaculate property is perfect for both entertaining and relaxing in true Palm Springs style.From the moment you enter, modern design and comfort greet you. Updated windows and doors fill the home with natural light while showcasing the gleaming tile flooring, designer color palettes, and surrounding mountain scenery. The flexible layout includes a spacious living area and a secondary sitting area ideal for lounging or reading.The open kitchen features light wood cabinetry, a full suite of stainless-steel appliances, a sleek tile backsplash, and a dining counter with a waterfall edge. Adjacent to the kitchen is a welcoming space with a fireplace currently serving as the dining area, which is ideal for gatherings and conversation. From here, sliding glass doors connect the interior to a private resort-inspired backyard complete with a sparkling pool, raised spa, and multiple seating areas. Several lounging zones feature low-maintenance artificial turf and there is a cozy gas firepit for evening enjoyment. A stylish dining pergola with bistro string lighting adds a touch of romance to outdoor entertaining.The primary suite opens directly to the backyard and offers a tranquil retreat with mountain views, ample closet space, and a beautifully updated en-suite bathroom. Two additional bedrooms are located at the front of the home with bright eastern exposure, accompanied by a designer hall bath featuring modern tile and fixtures.Additionally, there is an attached two-car garage with stacked laundry. The side yard provides RV parking in case your Airstream needs a home. For buyers seeking economic flexibility, this property qualifies for a junior rental permit through the City of Palm Springs, allowing up to six short-term rentals annually and unlimited stays of 30 days or longer--making it a perfect option for those wishing to offset living expenses with rental income.

A 3-car garage and RV parking are rare finds. Low HOA fees and low-maintenance landscaping make ownership easy. Mountain Gate residents enjoy three community pools and spas, tennis courts, a basketball court, and beautifully maintained grounds.

results.remarks: Experience the very best of South Palm Springs living in the highly sought-after Sunrise Villas community! Located on Fee Land (you own the land), this beautifully TURNKEY FURNISHED (Grace Home Furnishings, Ethan Allen, and Crate & Barrel) 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence is perfectly positioned with coveted southern exposure, breathtaking mountain views, and overlooks one of the community's sparkling pools from an expansive private patio surrounded by lush greenbelts. Inside, the light-filled open floor plan is enhanced by soaring vaulted ceilings, oversized windows and sliding glass doors, recessed lighting, and a seamless blend of contemporary style and timeless comfort. Additional upgrades include a newer HVAC system, tankless water heater, newer appliances, energy-efficient dual-pane windows, new custom window treatments, and new custom closet systems in every bedroom, providing exceptional comfort, organization, and efficiency. Two additional bedrooms provide flexibility for guests, a home office, or hobbies. Sunrise Villas offers resort-style amenities including multiple pools and spas, tennis and pickleball courts, beautifully maintained grounds, and a prime South Palm Springs location just minutes from downtown Palm Springs, Tahquitz Creek Golf Resort, shopping, dining, hiking, and entertainment.

results.remarks: This beautifully refreshed home offers an exceptional sense of privacy, openness, and light within the desirable 55+ community of Four Seasons. Additional features include an inside laundry room, thoughtful storage, refreshed exterior trim, and a newly painted garage door. Community amenities complete the lifestyle, including an Olympic-style swimming pool, spa, clubhouse, tennis courts, pickleball, fitness center, many resident activities, and more. High-speed Frontier Fiber Optic internet is included in the low HOA dues, a leased solar system helps reduce energy costs, and you own the land here (no land lease). Privacy, space, style, mountain views, energy efficiency, and resort-style amenities all come together in one standout home. You Found Your Happy Place!

Whether accommodating guests, extended family, or generating rental income, the possibilities are numerous. A 2-car garage is tucked behind gates for added privacy and convenience. Located in the Demuth Park neighborhood, you'll enjoy convenient access to the best of South Palm Springs, downtown dining and shopping, golf, hiking, and all the desert lifestyle has to offer.

results.remarks: MOTOR UP THE CIRCULAR DRIVE to this 1966 gem, originally marketed as a "Desert Alpine" vacation home and today a standout example of Palm Springs post-and-beam design in Movie Colony East. Modernist details are front and center, including exposed beams extending indoors and out, textured block walls, clerestory windows, and statement lighting. Offered TURNKEY FURNISHED, the open-concept living, dining, and kitchen areas have been beautifully updated while retaining their mid-century character, with stylish cabinetry, tilework, and a beverage fridge. Outside, a private backyard oasis is framed by mountain views to the west. Three bedrooms open directly to the pool area through sliders, while a playful fourth bedroom is tucked behind a mirrored door near the entry and enjoys its own private courtyard. Additional highlights include guest parking and a camera security system. Featured in HGTV Ideas Magazine! Fee Land (you own it) and just moments from Downtown and Uptown Palm Springs, this is one terrific mid-century getaway.

results.remarks: Thoughtfully updated and move-in ready, this three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath townhome-style condominium in gated Mountain Shadows offers effortless Palm Springs living on fee-simple land you own outright, with unobstructed western views of the San Jacinto Mountains and Tahquitz Creek public golf course just across the street. The vaulted living room features authentic hardwood flooring and a new ceiling fan, flowing into the open-concept tiled dining area and fully transformed kitchen — complete with new cabinetry, quartz countertops, a fixed peninsula prep area, premium appliances, and a glass and stone mosaic backsplash. Sliding glass doors off the dining area lead to a sunny enclosed rear courtyard with gated access to the assigned covered carport just beyond. The main-level third bedroom offers exceptional flexibility, with its own sliding door to a private front patio, a closet, a window, and accordion barn doors that open directly to the living room — ideal as a guest suite, home office, or media space. A refreshed powder room and concealed indoor laundry complete the first floor. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite features a private en suite bath, while the second bedroom enjoys new laminate flooring, a new ceiling fan, and wooden shutters. Both upstairs bedrooms feature brand-new laminate flooring. The updated second-floor guest bathroom features a granite-topped vanity, espresso cabinetry, and a walk-in stone tile shower with frameless glass enclosure. Additional features include thermal double-pane windows, HVAC replaced in 2018, wooden shutters throughout, and new ceiling fans in all bedrooms and the living room. Mountain Shadows is a gated, fee-simple community spanning roughly 25 landscaped acres with six pools, a spa, two lighted tennis courts, pickleball, a pavilion, on-site management, and mature citrus trees throughout the grounds. Short-term rentals are permitted with minimal community restrictions. Conveniently located near downtown Palm Springs, El Paseo, dining, shopping, hiking trails, and Palm Springs International Airport. Suitable as a primary residence, second home, or investment property.

results.remarks: This spacious, single-level end unit features three bedrooms and two bathrooms. The property stands out for its privacy, as it does not face another condo, and welcomes you through a private, gated courtyard entrance. Upon entering, you'll find an open, light-filled, and expansive living and dining area, enhanced by soaring wood-beamed ceilings and large 24x24 neutral-toned contemporary tile, which combine to create a sense of warmth and grandeur. The home is equipped with newer duo pane MILGARD windows throughout, allowing natural light to fill the space. The living room is highlighted by expansive sliding doors that open to a patio overlooking manicured green spaces, providing stunning mountain views and an excellent indoor-outdoor flow. For those with a green thumb, the property offers plenty of opportunities, and plantation shutters throughout allow you to control light and privacy. The well-appointed gourmet kitchen overlooks the entrance courtyard, bathing the space in natural light. It features stainless steel appliances and ample counter space to meet all your culinary needs. The primary ensuite bedroom and the main guest room and bath are thoughtfully separated, ensuring privacy for both spaces. The third bedroom is currently used as an office, offering flexibility for work or additional living arrangements. The attached single-car garage includes laundry facilities, and there is dedicated parking for two additional vehicles just outside. The property also boasts an upgraded electrical panel with EV charging capability and is wired for solar, enhancing both convenience and sustainability. Sunrise Oasis is a low-density community of just 96 homes spread across 13 acres. Residents enjoy access to three pools, three spas, and tennis/pickleball courts, all set among expansive green belts. The property is conveniently located minutes from Palm Springs' premier dining, shopping, and vibrant nightlife, making it an ideal place to call home.
